messages:
maria-support: Customer (FinAnalytics) reports embeddings API returning 400 dimension mismatch ~30% of calls since 07:00 UTC. Also seeing intermittent 401s and large tail latencies on same route. Can someone triage?

sam-engr: thanks, looking. Which model/route and client SDK version?

maria-support: route: POST /v1/embeddings model=all-embed-large-v2 client says SDK 0.18.2 (py). They pasted this error: `error: embeddings: vector dim 0 != expected 1536` - weird.

alex-ml: dimension 0 sounds like empty/padded payload hitting server. Could be client-side serialization bug where arrays get flattened to [] or [[ ]] -> empty inner. Also 401s separate maybe token rotation.

pam-sre: I pulled the logs for their tenant id 555: saw a cluster of requests that returned 401 from auth-gateway then retried -> routing to fallback pool which is lower capacity, causing queuing and tail latency spikes. timeline: 07:02 auth 401s, 07:03 bursts of embed 400s.

sam-engr: can we get a repro example from customer? ask them to attach raw request body and headers (no secrets).

maria-support: customer provided sanitized curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"all-embed-large-v2","input":[""]}'``` they said sometimes input is non-empty; only some requests create dim 0.

alex-ml: that curl shows empty string in array. empty string could produce zero-length embedding depending on tokenizer -> but embedding shape should still be 1536 floats, not 0. server returning dim 0 suggests a path where tokenization fails and returns empty vector or a client-side pre-processing hook removed content.

sam-engr: check dynamic batching hooks: if a request arrives with nil/payload due to JSON encoding bug, batcher might coalesce slots and produce a zero-length tensor for that slot. Looking at batcher metrics for tenant 555 around 07:03: batch_size distribution spiked, coalesce window 10ms, max_batch_size=128, some slots flagged as malformed -> I see a few `tensor_shape(0)` entries in logs.

pam-sre: interesting. I also see a quota check failure around same time that returned 401 from auth. Token rotation + transient 401 caused SDK to retry with empty body in some client versions (confirmed in their issue tracker). So two contributing factors.

sam-engr: repro plan: 1) ask customer to run a local loop that sends mix of normal and intentionally-empty inputs to try to reproduce dim 0. 2) on our side, reproduce with our internal SDK 0.18.2 and with/without token refresh race to try to hit the malformed payload. 3) run a test toggling dynamic batching/off and lower max_batch_size to see if batcher coalesce path hidden bug triggers.

maria-support: customer ran a quick loop and reproduced ~2/200 calls with 400 dim 0. They sent one raw request body that failed: `{ "model": "all-embed-large-v2", "input": [null] }`

alex-ml: null inside array could be deserialized to missing tensor slot. Batcher should reject null and return 400 with clear message; it should never pass a zero-dim tensor to embed kernel. That indicates a validation gap in the batcher pre-check.

sam-engr: temporary mitigation: we can patch batcher to drop null/empty slots earlier and return explicit 400. quick config workaround: disable dynamic batching for this tenant and set max_batch_size=32 on their route so requests are processed per-shard faster. That should reduce chance of malformed tensor propagation and reduce tail latency by avoiding fallback pool.

pam-sre: I can apply a per-tenant route override: `routes.tenant.555.dynamic_batching.enabled=false` and `routes.tenant.555.max_batch_size=32` for 1h while we debug. Also whitelisted their token to avoid token-rotation 401s during repro.

maria-support: customer agreed to temporary change. They asked for steps to reproduce on our side; they attached a small Python repro that flips between good/empty inputs.```python
import requests
for i in range(200):
    payload = {"model":"all-embed-large-v2","input":["text" if i%50!=0 else None]}
    r = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings", json=payload, headers={"Authorization":"Bearer REDACTED"})
    print(i, r.status_code, r.text[:120])
```

sam-engr: thanks — I ran similar locally, able to repro one dim 0 in 500-ish on a dev cluster when token refresh and request body race combined. I created an issue: BUG-embed-batcher-null-slot. Steps in issue: reproduce loop, enable strict validation in batcher to assert input tensor lengths >0, add unit tests.

alex-ml: engineering actions: 1) add validation hook in batcher (reject null/empty inputs pre-coalesce) 2) add server-side defensive check before calling embedding kernel to guard against zero-dim tensors and return 400 with helpful message 3) instrument metrics to count `null_slot_rejects` 4) backfill log search for prior occurrences.

pam-sre: I applied the route overrides and watched throughput: tail latency dropped from p99 1.8s -> 420ms for tenant 555, 400 errors stopped reproducing in their loop.

maria-support: customer confirmed immediate improvement and gave 👍. They want a postmortem + timeline.

sam-engr: I'll own the bugfix PR, target hotfix branch for next deploy (canary then prod). PR will include unit test and rollback plan.

alex-ml: add note to docs: client SDK versions <=0.18.2 had a retry race with token refresh that could resend altered body; recommend customers upgrade to 0.19.x which includes guard.

maria-support: filing follow-up ticket to Close loop with customer and schedule postmortem. Thanks all :heart:

infra-bot: deployment note: created BUG-embed-batcher-null-slot -> branch `fix/batcher-null-guard`, assigned to sam-engr, priority P1.

support-bot: thread closed by maria-support (temporary workaround applied).
